metaTitle: Custom NFC Enabled Keychains | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom NFC enabled keychains for bulk. Perfect for event marketing and contactless giveaways.
introHtml: Custom NFC enabled keychains combine a practical daily accessory with programmable smart technology, letting you link to a landing page, digital business card, or social profile with a simple tap. Unlike standard keychains, these work as interactive giveaways at trade shows, conferences, or employee onboarding kits. Decorate with your logo using pad printing or laser engraving, and pre-program each chip to direct recipients exactly where you want them. It's a memorable way to bridge physical swag and digital engagement.
heroAltText: Custom NFC enabled keychains with logo, programmable chip for contactless marketing giveaways
